## Forked Cat (CR 9)

**XP** 6,400  
 CE Small magical beast (shapechanger)  
 **Init** +4; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +10  

**Defense**

 **AC** 23 touch 15 flat-footed 19 (+4 Dex, +8 natural, +1 size)  
 **hp** 156 (12d10+36)  
 **Fort** +8 **Ref** +12 **Will** +8  
 **Immunities** disease, poison; **SR** 24  
 **Weakness** forked tail  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft.  
 **Melee** 2 claws +17 (1d3–1), bite +17 (1d4–1 plus grab)  
 **Space** 5 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  
 **Special Attacks** swallow whole (3d6 acid damage, AC 14, hp 10)  
 **Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 12th, concentration +18)  

  
  Constant—
  see invisibility
  

  At will—
  alter winds,
  command undead (DC 19),
  cause fear (DC 17),
  dancing lights,
  ghost sound (DC 16),
  mage hand,
  minor image (DC 18),
  obscuring mist,
  

  3/day—
  charm person (DC 17),
  chill touch (DC 17),
  darkness (DC 21),
  dream (DC 21),
  fireball (DC 19),
  gaseous form,
  ghoul touch (DC 18),
  gust of wind (DC 18),
  nightmare (DC 21)
  

  1/day—
  bestow curse (DC 19),
  call lightning (DC 19),
  contagion (DC 20),
  create greater undead (
  shadow,
  spectre or
  wraith only),
  raise dead
  

**Tactics**

 Forked cats are vicious, but physically weak. If they know their target, they’ll torment the target with illusions and weaken them with nightmares and diseases before attacking them with their undead minions and damaging spells.  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 8, **Dex** 18, **Con** 14, **Int** 14, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 22  
 **Base Atk** +12; **CMB** +10 (+16 grapple); **CMD** 24 (26 vs. grapple)  
 **Feats** Deceitful, Improved Grapple, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Toughness, Weapon Finesse  
 **Skills** Acrobatics +12, Bluff +20, Climb +10, Disguise +20, Knowledge (arcana) +5, Knowledge (religion) +5, Perception +10, Sense Motive +5, Stealth +16; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Climb, +4 Stealth  
 **Languages** Common, Aklo  
 **SQ** change shape (any humanoid as alter self, cat only as beast shape III), raise dead, speak with cats  

**Special Abilities**

 **Change Shape (Su)** A forked cat can turn into any humanoid creature as alter self or into a domestic cat (sizes Tiny to Huge) as per beast shape III. In its cat forms, it always has two tails.
